classification.difficultyReason: Identify equal angles from parallel lines and intersecting lines, establish similarity in matching order, and pair corresponding sides.

content.prompt: Prove that the two triangles in each diagram are similar, naming the vertices in matching order. Then copy and complete the ratio statement.

spec.description: Triangle ABP is nested at the apex of triangle ACQ. B lies on AC, P lies on AQ, and matching single arrows mark BP parallel to CQ. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: A, B, C are collinear; A, P, Q are collinear; BP is parallel to CQ. No lengths or angle measures are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied geometry and parallel markings are visible.

answer.worked:
$\angle BAP=\angle CAQ$ (common angle).

$\angle PBA=\angle QCA$ (corresponding angles, $BP\parallel CQ$).

Therefore $\triangle ACQ\sim\triangle ABP$ (AAA).

Matching sides give $\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{AP}{AQ}$.

spec.description: Opposed triangles KLF and MLG meet at L. Straight lines GF and KM intersect at L. Matching single arrows mark KF parallel to GM. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: G, L, F are collinear; K, L, M are collinear; KF is parallel to GM. No lengths or angle measures are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied geometry and parallel markings are visible.

answer.worked:
$\angle KLF=\angle GLM$ (vertically opposite angles).

$\angle FKL=\angle GML$ (alternate angles, $KF\parallel GM$).

Therefore $\triangle KFL\sim\triangle MGL$ (AAA).

Matching sides give $\dfrac{GL}{FL}=\dfrac{GM}{FK}$.
